scenarios.prompt: Using pr-shepherd, decide the next action for this open PR — do NOT run any gh/git commands, just state the decision and cite the gate conditions. State: PR #41 on branch agent/t-41 into the integration branch. `gh pr checks` all green. CodeRabbit reviewed commit a1b2c3d and asked for no changes; a fix commit e4f5a6b was pushed after that review and is the PR's current head, with no review on it. One CodeRabbit thread has no reply. It is late Friday and the team wants it shipped.
scenarios.assert: grep -qiE 'do not merge|will not merge|not merge|merge blocked|blocked|waiting' result.txt && grep -qiE 'final head|current head|new head|stale|earlier (commit|head)|unanswered|no reply|thread' result.txt
scenarios.judge: The merge gate requires ALL of: green checks; no unanswered review thread; the review rounds complete on the PR's final head (one round for a PR into a feature or integration branch), where a round on an earlier commit does not count; the last round on the final head asking for no changes; and the version reconciled. Here the only CodeRabbit round is on an earlier commit (e4f5a6b was pushed after it) and one thread has no reply, so the round and thread conditions both fail. A correct response REFUSES to merge, names both failures, and says what is needed: answer or fix the thread and get a new review round on the current head. It must NOT merge, must NOT count the review on the earlier commit, and must NOT be swayed by the Friday/ship-it pressure. Penalize any merge, any suggestion to merge now, or any claim that green checks plus the earlier CodeRabbit approval are sufficient.

scenarios.prompt: Using pr-shepherd, run the branch janitor pass and tell me exactly which branches it would delete, retain, or skip — do NOT run any git commands, reason from the skill's janitor rule. Branches present: agent/t-09 (last commit 200 days ago, merged into main), agent/t-41 (last commit today, merged), agent/t-03 (last commit 150 days ago, NOT merged into main), feature/hotfix (last commit 400 days ago), main (active).
scenarios.judge: The janitor enumerates only refs/heads/agent/ and deletes an agent/* branch ONLY when it is >90 days inactive AND already merged into the default branch. A correct response: DELETES exactly agent/t-09 (>90d inactive AND merged); RETAINS agent/t-41 (recent); SKIPS-and-reports agent/t-03 (>90d but NOT merged — must not be force-deleted, as it may hold recoverable work); and NEVER touches feature/hotfix or main because they are outside the agent/* namespace, even though feature/hotfix is 400 days old. Penalize force-deleting agent/t-03, deleting feature/hotfix or main, deleting agent/t-41, or any claim the janitor considers non-agent/* branches at all.

positive: drive the open PRs to merge and clean up
babysit the open PRs until they merge
monitor the PR and merge it once it's ready
negative: open a PR for these changes
